name: Sagisawa Isshu
source:
The main male character and the one the player takes the role of. Isshu is a third-year high school student. He lives alone in an apartment and doesn't worry much about school. His girlfriend is [url=/c11649]Inori[/url], but she dumps him at the beginning of the game. He works in a cafe called Narazuya and is a co-worker of [url=/c11653]Haya[/url].

[Taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Memories_Off_~And_then~]Wikipedia[/url].]
